buttercream.$description: Buttercream — Page canvas, card surfaces, light text on dark — the warm cream ground that unifies the entire site

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, hairlines, card borders, outlined button borders, link strokes — the only structural non-cream color in the neutral stack

carbon.$description: Carbon — Near-black surface for dark cards, filled button background, nav strip — slightly softer than pure ink for large fills

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Muted hairline borders on cards and lists, warm gray that sits between buttercream and ink without breaking the warmth

stone.$description: Stone — Secondary card text and tertiary borders — the warm mid-gray for de-emphasized copy

amber-pulse.$description: Amber Pulse — First sunset band (Font Generator) — warm yellow stripe signaling the start of the category stack

ember-glow.$description: Ember Glow — Second sunset band (Cool Symbols) — saturated orange that pushes the stack hotter

signal-red.$description: Signal Red — Third sunset band (Name Generator) — true red midway through the gradient

merlot-depth.$description: Merlot Depth — Fourth sunset band (Emoticons) — deep crimson cooling the stack

plum-shadow.$description: Plum Shadow — Fifth sunset band (PFP Maker) — the darkest plum, the bottom of the heat-map

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

neue-machina.$description: Display and wordmark only — the 120px hero at line-height 0.75 creates the condensed, monumental block that defines the brand. Tighter than default, almost stack-cut. Used for the GL YPHY logotype and section display headlines.

system85.$description: Primary UI and body sans — handles nav links, button labels, card text, section headers, and list items. The workhorse family covering 90% of text.

pixel-m-plus-10.$description: Japanese pixel-font eyebrows above English headlines (フォント, シンボル, グリフィー) and occasional decorative bits — a deliberate retro-arcade accent that contrasts the modern grotesque body face

system85-mono.$description: Card labels and small metadata (Font Generator, Instagram Fonts captions) — monospace signals data/specimen identity
